skill.name: test-gen
skill.description: Generate tests following Frontera test patterns. Use when user says "write tests", "add tests", "test this", "create unit tests", "generate tests", or asks to test a component/function/API.

generated_query: I've created a new API route at `app/api/invoices/route.ts` that handles GET and POST requests. GET returns all invoices for the current user's organization (requires auth), and POST creates a new invoice with validation. I need tests for both the route handler and the utility functions it uses (`validateInvoice` and `calculateTax`). The tests should cover auth failures (401), validation errors (400), successful creation, and edge cases like empty invoice list. We're using Vitest for unit tests, React Testing Library for component tests (though not needed here), and Playwright for E2E. The project already has patterns for mocking Clerk and Supabase. Please generate the necessary test files following the existing test structure.
